name: kaafil-demo-portals
description: A reference Kaafil integration inside a working partner CRM. `main` is the logic, unstyled; each client branch is only a skin.

scripts.dev: pnpm run seed && pnpm run build:sw && next dev

comment:seed:kaafil: Deliberately NOT part of `pnpm dev`. Pushing 56 departures into the tenant means 56 `journey.waitUntilReady` waits and a rate limit you will hit. Every call is an upsert, so running it twice is safe — but run it because fixtures changed, not because you restarted the dev server.
comment:secrets: KAAFIL_API_KEY has no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, so Next never inlines it. It is read by app/api/*/route.ts (server-only) and scripts/ingest.ts. lib/kaafil-server.ts carries `import 'server-only'` so a client component that imports it fails the build rather than shipping the key.
